utterance: My formula dragged down in Cell B3 = "=IF(MATCH("*USED*",A3,0)>0,"TRUCK ORDER NOT USED",2)" = "#N/A". Why does it not return "2" when false?
second_verdict: Remove column C. B3:B5 should be #N/A. Correct formula should be: =IF(ISNA(MATCH("*USED*",A3,0)),2,"TRUCK ORDER NOT USED").
